scope: Pine v5/v6 exported function result minimum simple qualifier, owner-verified immutable library context, consumer 1.1 admission and explicit host forwarding; source-only consumer 1.0 retained.
source_review: Export floor computes maximum(actual result qualifier, simple); nested If/Switch control sources retain series and reference/tuple strongest qualifier is not narrowed.

Library context authority is reconstructed from exact original pinned sources and canonical linker receipt. Generated identifier spelling, projected source alone, caller-supplied floor rows or self-resealed wrong origin data do not establish authority.
Bounds cover serialized receipt bytes, JSON depth/node count/cycles, library count and source bytes before canonical relinking. The rebuilt complete payload must equal the supplied immutable context.
Context declaration IDs are resolved against exact syntax AST identity and full declaration spans from the verified projection; private/root declarations do not acquire imported export authority.

Consumer 1.1 requires context, exact added capability and matching AST metadata marker. Admission reparses embedded source with reconstructed context and compares full AST/facts identities; optional externally supplied source must also match.

Consumer 1.0 lacks context and marker. Historical serialized bundles remain structurally admissible; explicit linked compilation requires new verified context and does not silently reinterpret legacy artifacts.
Compiler dependency identities originate in admitted linkage receipt, including when no redundant linked_source argument is supplied. Host forwards the same verified LinkedSource to producer build.

Reference target manifest changes only one capability and derived content_hash. Runtime manifest, catalog IDs, RC5 surface, permanent gates and semantic expected/source bundles are outside and unchanged by these 23 files.

old_test_preservation.normative_changes: Exactly 22 x 3 derived identity fields plus outer content_hash; original serialized consumer bundles, source maps, required operations/capabilities and all other manifest fields preserved.
